criteria.label: Non-text Content
criteria.remarks: Every image has a text alternative, and decorative images are hidden from screen readers.

criteria.label: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Body text meets the ratio. The "Draft" badge on unsent invoices measures 3.1 to 1.

criteria.label: Keyboard
criteria.remarks: Every function can be operated from a keyboard.

criteria.label: Focus Visible
criteria.remarks: The product's style sheet removes the browser's focus outline, and nothing replaces it.

criteria.label: Name, Role, Value
criteria.remarks: Every control is a native one, or exposes its name, role and state.
